svg.desc: Original hypothesis illustration. Arrows show the labeled proposed comparison, not observed results. Cell counts and shapes are qualitative. Read the full caption and sources.
svg.text: Can early regulation distinguish later AT1 competence?
RNA-similar transitional alveolar epithelial cells may differ in regulatory competence for later AT1 maturation. The remaining hypothesis would require
an early regulatory feature to distinguish later lineage-derived mature AT1 output beyond the starting RNA state. No particular regulatory feature has
yet been nominated for that prospective contrast; a generic chromatin assay does not complete it.
CANDIDATE - regulatory feature not yet nominated
RIVAL - apparent competence comes from the starting mixture
WHAT THE READOUTS WOULD LET YOU DECIDE
Specify the regulatory feature and why it should
mark competence. A generic ATAC assay is
Link early regulation and RNA to later
Added information supports a marker; it does not
show that changing it causes maturation.
Current evidence: Existing data do not provide the required regulation/RNA/later-outcome join. No regulatory target is selected here.
